ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution across approximately 90-95% of the visible fluke surface, with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing the remaining area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface area consists of a uniform dark pigmentation field. High-contrast contiguous white pixel blobs are concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes. A distinct high-intensity circular ring is located on the medial-lateral region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior angle of approximately 75 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing boundary characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged serrations (sharp peaks and shallow valleys) spanning the entire linear boundary from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The outer distal edges follow a smooth convex curve before transitioning into the serrated horizontal trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel formations are clearly visible at both the left and right distal tips, indicating localized surface irregularities.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, multi-directional diagonal linear pixel disruptions are visible on the left lobe, cutting through the primary low-intensity pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, high-contrast circular ring-shaped scar ('O-ring') is visible on the left lobe; heavy irregular encrustation and scarring are present at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive geometric circular scar on the left lobe surface and a notably deep, well-defined median notch.
